exposure: HIFU combined with systemic MTX followed by ultrasound-guided curettage or hysteroscopic resection
USgHIFU treatment for 3 days followed by ultrasound-guided curettage or hysteroscopic resection
outcome: Feasibility (e.g., successful extraction of placental tissue, recovery of normal menstruation)
cohort: This study included 21 patients diagnosed with retained placenta accreta (PA) with marked vascularity after abortion or delivery.
finding: Three-days' therapy of HIFU combined with or without systemic MTX followed by ultrasound-guided curettage or hysteroscopic resection appears to be a safe and feasible treatment for retained PA with marked vascularity after abortion or delivery.
followup_time: Up to 60 days after the operation (for menstruation recovery)
